_comment: Use cases for the use-case videos. tools/uc_timelines.py turns these plus the cut points in that script into timelines. 'answer' must match the reply on screen word for word (a trailing … marks a cut-off excerpt). All recorded on the ops_pixel emulator, release build 0.11.0 (then numbered 0.10.1), Standard tier (Gemma 4 E2B), airplane mode on.

vo: Need to be up early tomorrow? Just ask.

cases.prompt: What's the current weather in London?
cases.answer: London, United Kingdom: 8°C (47°F), mainly clear. Feels like 4°C, wind 16 km/h. Today 4–8°C, 0% chance of rain.
vo: Heading out? Ask about the weather.
Weather is the one feature that goes online. Only the city name is sent, and one switch turns it off.
cases._note: Recorded online (Wi-Fi), not in airplane mode, so it is a short only, not in the compilation.
